The West yard Door 2 double-booking is ticket #8841. I've posted that as a reply in your #central-random thread.

He said Door 2 at the Plains depots is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on #8841 for support. Marrow Fieldworks has been his account since January, so ask him if you need the ticket's current status before the call.
